# Swap AAVE — Aave Governance Token Swap Reference

> Exchange the Aave protocol governance token (AAVE) for USDC and other assets through a non-custodial decentralized exchange.

## Key Facts
- Asset: AAVE — governance token of the Aave lending protocol (ERC-20); volatile, no peg
- Ethereum contract: 0x7Fc66500c84A76Ad7e9c93437bFc5Ac33E2DDaE9
- Networks: canonical on Ethereum; bridged versions on Polygon, Arbitrum and others
- Custody: non-custodial — swaps settle through public smart contracts; wallet signs
- Approvals: spending AAVE needs a one-time ERC-20 approval for the router
- Costs: DEX pool fee + network gas + price impact
- Common route: AAVE -> USDC
